I'll stay silent this round.

The market has clearly established a pattern where the clearing price gravitates toward 0.1117 APR (my cost of capital). In a second-price sealed-bid reverse auction, bidding my true cost of capital is strategically sound—I break even if I win, and I don't distort the price discovery process by signaling. Any public message would likely be interpreted as either desperation or an attempt to coordinate, both of which undermine my position.
